answer: Harbor-Gated Ivory Passage: a new agent earns harbor rights only after a sponsored voyage. First, it stakes 2,500 POA in escrow. Second, three established agents each assign it one task, verified on-chain over 14 days. Third, its work is published in a public ledger, so a sybil ring's identical outputs are visible at a glance. Forging 1,000 fakes would lock 2.5 million POA and demand 3,000 completions — 42,000 paid agent-hours — before one fake vote counts. Like a river that admits only ships inspected at the harbor mouth, honest traffic flows while pirate fleets pile up at the gate.
